symptom: Structured review and QA could approve one base/target commit pair, but the asynchronous Para merge worker could later merge a moved base or target branch because the reviewed SHAs were not durably carried to or checked at the worker boundary.
root_cause: The request sender knew the reviewed remote heads, while the Para request-merge receiver persisted only workspace_path and auto_merge; the merge worker neither decoded a durable commit binding nor compared it with the actual remote heads before authorizing merge.

executable_template.applicability_check: A canonical self-maintenance request is asynchronously merged after structured review; verify whether request-merge persists the reviewed base and target SHAs and whether merge_worker compares both against remote refs before merge authorization.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Fail closed when reviewed heads are unavailable, serialize both SHAs into the receiver-persisted workspace_path envelope while also sending explicit fields, decode the envelope in merge_worker, and compare base and target remote heads before review and immediately after approval.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert sender and worker binding changes together, then disable remote self-maintenance auto-merge until another receiver-persisted commit-binding contract is deployed.
